A valid complete bounded empty provider page is COMPLETE with count0 and sealed raw proof. UI visible empty is a successful empty observation with incomplete/exhaustive=false coverage; it cannot meet full-windowCOMPLETE without provider completeness proof. This is the correct distinction for frozen A05-05, not an exception permitting fabricated X coverage.

Requested window, actual provider query window, observed item min/max and accessible scope are distinct fields. A single PR/readme/pinned paper is narrow per-reference scope. Twenty X search articles or observed_tail marker is not a durable provider pagination cursor and does not prove exhaustive history.

Keep existing origin checks, body-size limits, exact detail-page author/URL/time match, duplicate identity/provenance, retry waiting and prompt-as-data handling. No independent watchlist/scheduler, extra account, token extraction or alternative browser.
